descriptionHtml:
'HERSELF' is a competition for creative concepts organized by WIE UOP to celebrate Women’s Day 2022, following the theme “Women Empowerment”. The contest is open to all enthusiastic, creative people in Sri Lanka. Contestants will participate in three categories, Video Creating, Poem Writing, and Poster Designing. The best creations will be chosen by a panel of judges consisting of industry experts, academic staff members of the university, and school teachers.

The panel of Judges : 

Ms. Damayanthi Herath (Senior Lecturer, Department of Computer Engineering, University of Peradeniya)

Ms. Heshani Mahalaksha (Vice-chair, IEEE WIE Sri Lanka Section, Electrical and Electronic Engineer, CEB)

Ms. Gresha S. Samarakkodi (Assistant Secretary, IEEE WIE Sri Lanka Section, Lecturer- Electronic and Telecommunication Engineering)

Ms. Upeksha Kudagamage (Lecturer, Department of Computing and Information Systems, Sabaragamuwa University of Sri Lanka)

Ms. Sriyakanthi Manike (Art Teacher, Post Graduate Diploma in Education Archeology)
